text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since
Matikanetannhauser's debut race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
We got big trouble, big trouble!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well, you see!
For now, the TV, TV, the TV!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hurrying to turn on the TV as urged—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"Interviewing this year's hottest newcomers!
Our featured debutante today is Mihono Bourbon,
who showcased incredible talent in her debut race!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Bourbon-san really is
running and running right there on the TV~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, I heard you were being interviewed!
That's so amazing~! As someone who debuted
around the same time, I feel so proud!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Chukyo Racecourse, the stage of her debut race, was abuzz with excitement over Mihono Bourbon's extraordinary talent.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
A late start, followed by a ferocious charge down the final stretch
to cross the finish line in first! Man, that gave me chills!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Her lower body is remarkably solid too,
so I'm sure she'll just keep growing and improving, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"You're being called the big rookie to watch, but point-blank,
what are your current goals in the Twinkle Series!?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My only target is
to claim the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see...! Pardon me, but that's a bit surprising. I was certain you were aiming for the sprint route...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Her aptitude may lean toward sprints, but that is irrelevant.
The Triple Crown remains an absolute requirement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoa...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The way she declared that so nonchalantly in front of the camera showed she had truly mastered the role.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! So cool!
As expected of Bourbon-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait, if we're going for the Triple Crown,
does that mean I'll have to race against Bourbon-san?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh my-!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, around that time,
the same broadcast was playing in the dormitory lobby.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
“—Up next, a special feature on the Umamusume
making waves in the Classic and Senior classes!”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, you mean those two?

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Hailed now as the ultimate stayer—Mejiro McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: And having swept the Satsuki Sho and Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby) undefeated, the genius Tokai Teio claims the Double Crown!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Man, you're really something else...

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: "A star-studded lineup of leading-lady Umamusume is assembled here today! The day they clash on the track may soon arrive!"

text_block_list.name: Expert
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. Still, it's such a shame about
Tokai Teio's injury right after the Derby."

text_block_list.name: Expert
text_block_list.text:
"Wasn't it six months to recover? I heard she's skipping the Kikuka Sho.
I was so sure she'd win the Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. There were many eager voices
anticipating the birth of a Triple Crown Umamusume. Personally,
I find it truly regrettable that she had to withdraw."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...If only I could've run, the Triple Crown would've been guaranteed...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...
...That's, true... isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh, ran my heart out today too!
Good work today, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that... Nature?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Matikanetannhauser's gaze, I saw
Nice Nature staring out at the grounds with
a somewhat somber look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Actually, Trainer.
Er, she's been like that for the past few days.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly, I'm getting a little worried.
..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm going to go talk to them for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature's fortune for today:
Small Blessing! Might be a slightly gloomy day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Not to worry, though! Your lucky Umamusume
is the girl whose name starts with "Ma" and ends with "za"!
Have a chat with her and your mood will instantly brighten!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, what's up so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Um...
Pretending to be Fuku-chan-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Right now, this lucky horse girl is all ears for whatever you wanna talk about~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Just kiddin'.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—*giggle*, haha...!
What are you even doing, seriously...?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, thanks.
I made you worry, didn't I? I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, mind hearing me out for a second?
Miss Umamusume whose name starts with "Ma" and ends with "za".

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, so...
I'm thinking I wanna run in the Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Originally, Teio inspired me to give it my all,
so I was logging a decent amount of miles, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I saw a TV segment lamenting how Teio couldn't run in the Kikuka Sho, and it got me thinking.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Claiming that she definitely would've won the Triple Crown if she ran... People really just say whatever they want...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Teio knows that better than anyone!
...But she still can't run.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, my dream was to become an
undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume, and I worked
so hard for it, but now it's impossible...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Swallowing all that frustration, only to hear everyone say, "She would've definitely won if she ran"…… That's rough. Super rough.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, whoever wins the Kikuka Sho
is bound to have this said about them."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who won the Kikuka Sho
that Teio couldn't run in...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Just hypothetically, if I managed to win the Kikuka Sho, I'd definitely be super happy, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I guess there'll always be that asterisk—
'if only Teio had been in the race'...”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, what am I even saying
before the race has even started?
I just keep letting my mind wander to pointless stuff—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, jeez! I'm so lame!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I need to concentrate right now and really put in the miles, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikane Tannhauser quietly gazed
at Nice Nature's downcast face.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What would Tannhauser do at a time like this?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? If it were me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmm, yeah... But I think I normally would've thought the exact same thing as Nature.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Because it'd still bother me. I think I'd just end up feeling uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Even so, setting that aside, I think deep down in the back of your mind you've always wanted to win the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...So, yeah, that's it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'll try to take 1st place so convincingly
that no one will ever say 'what if Teio were here!'

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think that's the only way!
To the point where everyone forgets about Teio—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'll win by a landslide!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Are you listening?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sudden silence. The two of them wore dumbfounded
expressions. And then—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, fufu, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? What!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez! Right, that's just the kind of person you are.
...That woke me right up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta face forward and hold my ground.
Whining about it won't do any good, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, I'll win. I'm going to leave them all in the dust. It's definitely not impossible for me."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...!
I'm not sure why, but are you feeling better now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: There it is, there it is... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Woo-hoo! We did it, we did it, we did it!
What now? Wanna sprint into the sunset?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
No freaking way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two head back to the academy, playfully teasing each other.
Nice Nature's face is bright and beaming.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"‘Even if you don't shine like the sun,
that weapon of yours is one of a kind!
It even has the power to take someone's hand and push them forward!’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a moment, I felt as if Chairwoman Akikawa's words from that day echoed down from the high sky.
